verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp ships a local server (`llama serve`, 'Server'), so a concurrency-limit question applies to it. Nothing in the pack documents a maximum number of concurrent requests or connections, or where throughput starts to degrade. The community benchmarks report only single-session per-token speeds, which is a different measurement.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented maximum concurrent requests or connections the local server can handle before throughput degrades
